description: Lists the chat templates Mimicly can fill in: messaging apps (for example WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Discord) and AI chat apps (for example ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini). Returns each template id, display name, category, whether it can be recorded as an animated video in Mimicly, and whether clean export needs Mimicly Pro. Call it when you are not sure which template id to pass to create_chat_mockup.

category.description: Optional filter. "messages" for messaging apps, "ai-chat" for AI assistant chats.

name: list_templates

access.description: Clean export of "pro" templates needs Mimicly Pro; everyone can open and edit them.

recordable.description: Can be recorded as an animated video in Mimicly.

title: List Mimicly chat templates
